_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 3: Sales Funnel: Quote -> Order -> Invoice (Q2C). Eleven new schemas (Quote, QuoteLine, SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine, Delivery, Invoice, InvoiceLine, CreditNote, PricingTier, VolumeDiscount, BlanketOrder, CreditHold) covering the quote-to-cash workflow for Dutch SMEs: versioned non-binding quotes with multi-channel acceptance, binding sales orders with partial delivery / backorder tracking, delivery (Levering) shipments, delivery/advance/consolidated invoicing with Dutch sequential numbering, BTW per line (binnenland / intracommunautair reverse-charge), Peppol BIS 3.0 / UBL 2.1 outbound e-invoicing, customer-specific pricing tiers + volume discounts, blanket-order call-off, automated AR-ageing credit holds, and credit notes with AR offset. All quantitative + reporting logic is declarative (x-openregister-calculations / x-openregister-aggregations) per ADR-031. No QuoteService.php / OrderService.php / InvoiceService.php. Cross-field / cross-schema lifecycle preconditions delegate to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\QuoteOrderInvoiceGuard (ADR-031 exception path). A customer/contact is a Nextcloud entity (NC addressbook / AR customer master) referenced by customerReference FK. Never re-declared here. GL posting, AR open-item creation, IFRS 15 Contract/PO linking, VIES validation, e-signature, Peppol dispatch, shipping and CRM integrations are FK references / openconnector calls delegated to the dependency apps (bookkeeping-general-ledger, bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core, bookkeeping-ifrs15-revenue, openconnector, docudesk). See tasks.md for deferred items. Seed data pre-loads a worked B2B / retail / public-sector quote -> order -> delivery -> invoice scenario set.

Quote.title: Quote
Quote.description: Verkoopofferte: a versioned, non-binding sales offer with multi-channel acceptance (design D1). Schema:Offer per ADR-011.

customerReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the customer: a Nextcloud addressbook contact / AR customer master. Never a re-declared Customer schema (guardrail).
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

version.description: Quote version. Each revision increments; prior versions are retained as immutable snapshots (design D1).
version.title: Version

supersedesQuote.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the prior version this quote supersedes.
supersedesQuote.title: Supersedes Quote

validUntil.description: Validity expiry date: quote auto-expires after this.
validUntil.title: Valid Until

language.description: Quote language (nl / en) for generated document.
language.title: Language

deliveryTerms.description: Incoterms 2020 delivery terms (e.g. EXW, DAP, DDP).
deliveryTerms.title: Delivery Terms

responsibleSalesperson.description: NC user id of the responsible salesperson.
responsibleSalesperson.title: Responsible Salesperson

relatedOpportunityReference.description: FK / external id to a CRM opportunity (openconnector sync).
relatedOpportunityReference.title: Related Opportunity Reference

acceptanceChannel.description: How the quote was accepted (design D1).
acceptanceChannel.title: Acceptance Channel

acceptanceEvidenceReference.description: FK URI (docudesk / e-signature provider) to acceptance evidence.
acceptanceEvidenceReference.title: Acceptance Evidence Reference

documentReference.description: FK URI to the docudesk-generated quote PDF (bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration).
documentReference.title: Document Reference

administrationId.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the owning administration (multi-tenant scope).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

sent.label: Sent
sent.description: Quote sent to the customer, awaiting response.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: Customer accepted; ready to convert to a sales order.

send.label: Send quote
send.description: Send the quote to the customer. Blocked unless at least one quote line is present and the customer reference is set.

accept.label: Accept quote
accept.description: Record acceptance via in-app signed URL, e-signature provider, or manual back-office (design D1). Blocked unless an acceptance channel is recorded.

revise.label: Revise quote
revise.description: Return to draft to issue a new version; the sent version is retained as an immutable snapshot (design D1).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Quote is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

QuoteLine.title: Quote Line
QuoteLine.description: A line on a Quote. FK to Quote.

lineNumber.description: Ordinal line number on the quote.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

unitPrice.description: Resolved unit price (after pricing-tier resolution, design D6).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

appliedTierName.description: Name of the pricing tier applied (line-level transparency, design D6).
appliedTierName.title: Applied Tier Name

vatRate.description: BTW rate applied to this line (0 / 9 / 21).
vatRate.title: BTW Rate

glAccount.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the revenue GL Account.
glAccount.title: GL Account

costOfGoodsEstimate.description: Estimated cost of goods for margin reporting.
costOfGoodsEstimate.title: Cost Of Goods Estimate

lineNet.description: lineNet = quantity * unitPrice * (1 - discount/100). Declarative per ADR-031: no PHP pricing service.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Quote Line is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

SalesOrder.title: Sales Order
SalesOrder.description: Verkooporder: a binding sales commitment with partial-delivery / backorder tracking (design D2). Schema:Order per ADR-011.

customerReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the customer (Nextcloud contact / AR customer master).
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

sourceQuoteReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the accepted Quote this order was converted from.
sourceQuoteReference.title: Source Quote Reference

contractReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the IFRS 15 Contract created on conversion (bookkeeping-ifrs15-revenue).
contractReference.title: Contract Reference

invoicingMode.description: When invoices are generated for this order (design D4).
invoicingMode.title: Invoicing Mode

creditCheckResult.description: Outcome of the AR credit check on confirmation (design D9).
creditCheckResult.title: Credit Check Result

blanketOrderFlag.description: Whether this order is a call-off release against a blanket order (design D8).
blanketOrderFlag.title: Blanket Order Flag

masterOrderReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the parent BlanketOrder for a call-off release.
masterOrderReference.title: Master Order Reference

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Order being prepared (e.g. just converted from a quote).

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Binding; credit check passed; awaiting fulfilment.

partial.label: Partially delivered
partial.description: Some but not all lines delivered (backorder open).

confirm.label: Confirm order
confirm.description: Run the AR credit check (design D9) and confirm. Blocked when a block-severity credit hold applies to the customer.

deliverPartial.label: Record partial delivery
deliverPartial.description: A delivery covered some lines; backorder remains.

deliverPartialAgain.label: Record further partial delivery
deliverPartialAgain.description: Another delivery against an order still carrying backorder.

ship.label: Complete shipment
ship.description: Final delivery cleared the backorder; all lines delivered.

shipDirect.label: Ship in full
shipDirect.description: Single delivery covered the whole order.

close.label: Close order
close.description: Order fully delivered, invoiced, and paid.

SalesOrderLine.title: Sales Order Line
SalesOrderLine.description: A line on a SalesOrder tracking ordered / delivered / invoiced / backorder quantities (design D2). FK to SalesOrder.

deliveredQuantity.description: Quantity delivered so far (incremented by delivery confirmations, design D3).
deliveredQuantity.title: Delivered Quantity

unitPrice.description: Resolved unit price (stored at confirmation, design D6).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

appliedTierName.description: Pricing tier applied (line-level transparency, design D6).
appliedTierName.title: Applied Tier Name

backorderQuantity.description: backorderQuantity = max(orderedQuantity - deliveredQuantity, 0). Declarative per ADR-031 (design D2).

Delivery.title: Delivery
Delivery.description: Levering: a shipment record linking a SalesOrder to invoicing (design D3). Schema:ParcelDelivery per ADR-011.

sourceOrderReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the SalesOrder being shipped.
sourceOrderReference.title: Source Order Reference

lines.description: Shipped line quantities: [{ orderLineReference, productReference, quantityShipped }].
lines.title: Lines

proofOfDeliveryReference.description: FK URI (docudesk) to the proof-of-delivery document.
proofOfDeliveryReference.title: Proof Of Delivery Reference

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Quantities confirmed; order line deliveredQuantity updated; invoicing may trigger.

confirm.label: Confirm delivery
confirm.description: Confirm shipped quantities and update SalesOrderLine.deliveredQuantity (design D3). Blocked unless every line references an order line and a positive quantity, and the customer is not under a block-delivery credit hold.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Delivery is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Factuur: a sales invoice with Dutch sequential numbering, BTW, and Peppol BIS 3.0 / UBL 2.1 dispatch (design D4/D5/D11). Schema:Invoice per ADR-011. No deletion (Belastingdienst). Reverse with a CreditNote only.

invoiceNumber.description: Dutch sequential invoice number (no gaps; Belastingdienst).
invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number

customerReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the customer (Nextcloud contact / AR customer master).
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

vatLegend.description: BTW legend (e.g. reverse-charge / btw verlegd, intracommunautaire levering Article 196).
vatLegend.title: BTW Legend

viesValidated.description: Whether the customer EU VAT number was VIES-validated for reverse-charge.
viesValidated.title: Vies Validated

glTransactionReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the materialised GL posting (bookkeeping-general-ledger).
glTransactionReference.title: GL Transaction Reference

arOpenItemReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the AR open item (bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core).
arOpenItemReference.title: AR Open Item Reference

peppolMessageId.description: Peppol message id returned by the access point on dispatch.
peppolMessageId.title: Peppol Message ID

ublXmlReference.description: FK URI to the generated UBL 2.1 / Peppol BIS 3.0 XML.
ublXmlReference.title: Ubl XML Reference

documentReference.description: FK URI to the docudesk-generated invoice PDF.
documentReference.title: Document Reference

sent.label: Sent
sent.description: Issued: GL posting materialised, AR open item created, dispatched (optionally via Peppol).

issue.label: Issue invoice
issue.description: Issue: materialise the GL posting (debit AR, credit revenue, credit BTW; advance -> deferred revenue), create the AR open item, validate BTW (VIES if intracommunautair), generate UBL, and dispatch (Peppol if the customer has a Peppol id). Blocked unless the invoice has at least one line, a sequential number, and a balanced net/vat/gross total.

cancel.label: Cancel draft
cancel.description: Cancel a draft invoice before issue (issued invoices are never deleted: Belastingdienst).

markOverdue.label: Mark overdue
markOverdue.description: Due date passed without full payment (drives AR ageing / credit holds).

credit.label: Credit invoice
credit.description: Reverse via a credit note (design D10).

InvoiceLine.title: Invoice Line
InvoiceLine.description: A line on an Invoice. FK to Invoice.

unitPrice.description: Unit price (carried from the order line).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

glAccount.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the revenue GL Account.
glAccount.title: GL Account

CreditNote.title: Credit Note
CreditNote.description: Creditfactuur: reverses an invoice with automatic AR offset (design D10). Schema:Invoice per ADR-011. Dutch sequential numbering; no deletion.

sourceInvoiceReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the Invoice being reversed.
sourceInvoiceReference.title: Source Invoice Reference

glTransactionReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the materialised GL reversal posting.
glTransactionReference.title: GL Transaction Reference

arOffsetReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the AR offset / customer credit (bookkeeping-accounts-receivable-core).
arOffsetReference.title: AR Offset Reference

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: GL reversal posted and AR offset created.

applied.label: Applied
applied.description: Offset applied against the customer balance.

issue.label: Issue credit note
issue.description: Post the GL reversal (debit revenue / credit AR) and create the AR offset (design D10). Blocked unless the source invoice is set, a reason is recorded, and the amount is positive.

apply.label: Apply credit
apply.description: Apply the credit against the customer balance.

PricingTier.title: Pricing Tier
PricingTier.description: Prijsniveaus: customer / customer-group / product-group quantity-break pricing resolved in priority order (design D6).

name.description: Pricing-tier name (shown on order lines for transparency).
name.title: Name

customerReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to a specific customer (highest priority). Mutually informative with customerGroupReference.
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

customerGroupReference.description: FK / code for a customer group (second priority).
customerGroupReference.title: Customer Group Reference

productGroupReference.description: FK / code for a product group (default tier).
productGroupReference.title: Product Group Reference

breakpoints.description: Quantity-break -> unit-price entries: [{ minQuantity, maxQuantity, unitPrice, discountPercent }].
breakpoints.title: Breakpoints

priority.description: Resolution priority (lower = higher precedence): 1 customer-specific, 2 customer-group, 3 product-group, 4 list.
priority.title: Priority

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pricing Tier is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

VolumeDiscount.title: Volume Discount
VolumeDiscount.description: Volumekortingen: time-bounded, customer-eligible promotional rules applied automatically (design D7).

discountPercent.description: Discount percentage applied when the rule fires.
discountPercent.title: Discount Percent

productReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to a specific Product the rule targets.
productReference.title: Product Reference

customerEligibility.description: Who the rule applies to (design D7).
customerEligibility.title: Customer Eligibility

eligibleCustomerReferences.description: FK list (slug/uuid) of eligible customers (when customerEligibility = customer-list).
eligibleCustomerReferences.title: Eligible Customer References

automaticApplication.description: Whether the rule applies automatically at quote / order time.
automaticApplication.title: Automatic Application

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Volume Discount is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

BlanketOrder.title: Blanket Order
BlanketOrder.description: Blancokorder: a master commitment with call-off releases drawn over months and remaining-quantity tracking (design D8).

committedQuantity.description: Total authorised quantity over the commitment.
committedQuantity.title: Committed Quantity

calledOffQuantity.description: Quantity released through call-off SalesOrders so far.
calledOffQuantity.title: Called Off Quantity

agreedUnitPrice.description: Agreed unit price for the commitment.
agreedUnitPrice.title: Agreed Unit Price

callOffOrderReferences.description: FK list (slug/uuid) of child SalesOrder call-off releases (design D8).
callOffOrderReferences.title: Call Off Order References

expiryHandling.description: What happens to the remaining quantity on expiry (design D8).
expiryHandling.title: Expiry Handling

remainingQuantity.description: remainingQuantity = max(committedQuantity - calledOffQuantity, 0). Declarative per ADR-031 (design D8).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Blanket Order is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

CreditHold.title: Credit Hold
CreditHold.description: Kredietstop: an automated, audit-trailed customer credit hold triggered by AR-ageing thresholds (design D9).

customerReference.description: FK (slug/uuid) to the customer under hold.
customerReference.title: Customer Reference

severity.description: Hold severity (design D9): warning blocks nothing, block-order prevents order confirmation, block-delivery prevents shipment.
severity.title: Severity

reason.description: Why the hold was applied (e.g. open AR > threshold AND > N days overdue).
reason.title: Reason

openBalanceAtTrigger.description: Open AR balance that triggered the hold.
openBalanceAtTrigger.title: Open Balance At Trigger

daysOverdueAtTrigger.description: Days overdue of the oldest open item at trigger.
daysOverdueAtTrigger.title: Days Overdue At Trigger

createdBy.description: NC user id (or 'system' for the scheduled workflow) that applied the hold.
createdBy.title: Created By

releasedBy.description: NC user id (Credit Controller) that released the hold.
releasedBy.title: Released By

releaseReason.description: Why the hold was released (e.g. payment plan agreed, dispute resolved).
releaseReason.title: Release Reason

release.label: Release hold
release.description: Credit Controller lifts the hold (design D9). Blocked unless a releasedBy and a releaseReason are recorded (audit trail).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Credit Hold is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
